name: Braised Chicken Thighs with Mushrooms and Leeks
ingredients_verbatim: 2 large or 3 medium leeks, whites only
8 pieces bone-in, skin-off chicken thighs, trimmed, about 40 ounces
1 cup chicken broth or water with chicken bouillon
why: Verified in-band on the source's own numbers: 445 cal, 13g carbs, 59.5g protein per serving - lands mid-band with room under both gates. A true French-style braise (bone-in thighs browned then oven-braised in a sherry-mushroom-leek sauce), structurally low-carb (no rice/pasta/potato base). Not in the catalog (leeks + sherry braise is uncovered; distinct from the accepted french-chicken-fricassee, which is a cream fricassee). Bone-in thighs in a covered braise scale cleanly to 14 with weigh-and-divide. Sherry is the one board-absent ingredient - flagged for the pricer lane, not dropped.
